library.name: React
library.description: React is bundled into the prebuilt editor AMD module (amd/build/editor_lazy.min.js) for Moodle versions without native React runtime support. Built from source in js/src via the development-only esbuild toolchain (build.mjs); the accompanying editor_lazy.min.js.map lets Moodle serve this artefact directly in developer mode. The bundle carries a license banner listing every third-party component it contains.

library.name: ReactDOM
library.description: ReactDOM is bundled into the prebuilt editor AMD module together with React (see the React entry for build details).

library.name: Scheduler
library.description: Scheduler (a ReactDOM runtime dependency) is bundled into the prebuilt editor AMD module together with React and ReactDOM.
